title: 6550--FY26: Leica Bond III Reagents
agency_path: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.248-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 8 (36C248)
detail_text: NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD A SOLE SOURCE CONTRACT TO Government Scientific Source Inc, 12355 Sunrise Valley DR STE 400, Reston Virginia 20191, for Leica Bond Reagents for the Orlando Healthcare System, 13800 Veterans Way, Orlando, FL 32827. This procurement is being conducted in accordance with 41 USC 3304(a)(1) as implemented by FAR 6.302-1. The North American Industry Classification System code for this procurement is 334516 and the small business administrative size standard is 1,000 Employees. The current Federal Acquisition Circular is 2025-06 dated 10/1/2025. If vendors believe they have the technical capability to meet this specific need, submit a complete technical package, which provides clear and convincing evidence that they can meet the Government s requirement. Submit your response to this notice no later than 03/23/2026, 1:00 PM Eastern Standard Time to Contracting Officer, Benjamin Amato, benjamin.amato@va.gov. Any responses received will be considered for the purposes of validating the requirement as sole source. The Government will not pay for information submitted. This will be the only notice of the Government s intent to solicit, and award to one source to satisfy this requirement.
